title: Wyndham Nashville- 1 bdrm- Opry & Gaylords Palms
description:
This timeshare property is minutes from the Grand Old Opry.  

This is a one bedroom condo with a king bed and sofa bed. It has a full kitchen, balcony/patio and washer/dryer.

The space
Benefits of a timeshare quality resort without ownership.

Guest access
Amenities
2 Outdoor Swimming Pools
Organized Activities Program
Outdoor Hot Tub
Live Entertainment
Basketball
Indoor Swimming Pool
Exercise Equipment
Playground
Picnic/BBQ Area

Other things to note
Host takes the name that you provide to airbnb so if it is not your legal name be sure to let host know PRIOR to purchase.  Guest is responsible for name change fees if they sent an alternate traveler or if their name registered with airbnb is not a legal name.  Fees are $99-$198.

Units are non-smoking, no pets allowed. 
Guest must follow all rules and regulations set by the resort. 
Guest must be at least 21 years old and supply a valid government issued ID as well as a credit card for incidentals.
